title: acmeserver: say when the CA database is locked by another process
body:
Fixes #8004

Running `caddy validate` while Caddy is already running only reported "Error opening database of Type bbolt: timeout" for configs with `acme_server`, which reads like a broken config or a corrupt database.

`openDatabase()` now catches `bolterrors.ErrTimeout` with `errors.Is` and adds the missing context:

> Error opening database of Type bbolt: timeout: CA database /path/to/db is locked by another process; if Caddy is already running, use 'caddy reload' instead of 'caddy validate'

Added `TestHandler_openDatabaseLocked`, which holds a real lock on the bbolt file and checks that the error wraps `bolterrors.ErrTimeout` and explains the lock. It is skipped under `-short` since it waits out bbolt's 5 second timeout.

`go mod tidy` dropped the `// indirect` marker on `go.etcd.io/bbolt`. No version change.

### Assistance Disclosure

I used an LLM to reproduce the issue after writing the regression.
